articles.mainIdea: Eikon, a high-profile startup led by Merck vets, seeks an IPO
articles.summary: BioPharma Dive: Eikon, a high-profile startup led by Merck vets, seeks an IPO. Run by Roger Perlmutter and backed by more than $1 billion in private funding, Eikon will use the IPO proceeds to advance a group of experimental cancer drugs.
